INSERT INTO noise_diagnostic_configs (
                id,
                optimization_type_name,
                probe_population_size,
                probe_min_evaluations,
                probe_max_evaluations,
                budget_id,
                revised_at
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
            RETURNING
                id,
                optimization_type_name,
                probe_population_size,
                probe_min_evaluations,
                probe_max_evaluations,
                budget_id
